0: Cardiac arrhythmia (Premature ventricular contractions - PVCs, Non-sustained ventricular tachycardia - NSVT)

cohort.0: Two pregnant women with non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) implanted with a cardioverter defibrillator (ICD) were followed clinically throughout their pregnancies.

finding.0: During pregnancy, patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy develop progressive neuroautonomic imbalance, leading to an increase in non-sustained ventricular arrhythmia.

followup_time.0: Until delivery (throughout the entire course of pregnancy)
